description: Public JSON Schema contract for the authored documents of a connection package: where each sits, read from the connection's own directory (the one holding `connection.json`), and the published schema it is written against. It holds locations only; each document's shape is the schema it points at. Other files a package carries are outside this schema. Source of truth: analitiq.contracts.connection_package.ConnectionPackage (Pydantic).
title: Analitiq Connection Package
